ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Computational Geometry. Fundamental algorithms and data structures for solving (mostly low-dimensional) geometric problems. Fundamental topics include convex hulls, Voronoi diagrams, polygon triangulation, range searching, and geometric optimization. More advanced topics will depend on student interest; possible topics include finite-element mesh generation, surface reconstruction, dimensionality reduction, computational topology, kinetic data structures, and lower bounds. Mathematically and/or algorithmically mature undergraduates are welcome.
